settings.title: Settings
settings.description: When enabled, the collector reads the logs of all cluster nodes, removes personal data and sends a summary to the Nethesis insights service every 15 minutes. The service analyzes it and reports problems in the Insights page.
settings.base_url_helper: Root URL of the server, with no path
settings.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL
settings.subscription_required_description: The insights service accepts data only from machines with an active subscription. Activate a subscription in the cluster Settings to enable this module.
settings.active_elsewhere_description: Log analysis is already enabled on {instance}. Only one instance per cluster can be enabled, because each one reads the logs of the whole cluster.

insights.title: Insights
insights.page_description: Problems found in the cluster logs by the Nethesis insights service. New kinds of problems are reviewed by Nethesis before they are shown here.
insights.no_findings_description: No problems found in the cluster logs. Findings appear here after the insights service has analyzed the data.
insights.collector_disabled_description: Enable it in the Settings page to send new data to the insights service.
insights.subscription_required: A subscription is required to read the findings
insights.server_unauthorized: The insights server rejected the subscription credentials
insights.server_tls_error: The TLS certificate of the insights server is not valid
insights.server_error: The insights server returned an error
